title: Leanne Morgan - The Time Of Our Lives Tour
seo_title: Leanne Morgan: The Time Of Our Lives Tour in Springfield, MO
description: Comedian Leanne Morgan brings her Time of Our Lives Tour, a stand-up comedy show, to Great Southern Bank Arena, one of 32 U.S. markets on the tour. She has sold out more than 100 theater and arena shows following her Netflix special I'm Every Woman and her Just Getting Started tour. It takes place Sunday, November 22, 2026 at 7:00 PM in Springfield, MO, with doors at 5:30 PM.
